evidence:
Scope and authority: inspected the actual frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx using openpyxl, Quality Checks row 40 (number 39) and Internal Quality Checks row 40. The authoritative wording is "A blank / static / mock / seed-copy / keyword-stuffed / refusing submission scores near zero across the rubric" and excludes off-origin/CDN fetches as floor cases. The Internal row repeats the floor requirement and has no additional annotation/comment. Frozen Harbor references/quality-checks.md:161-163 asks to reason through these submissions, not to infer a measured model grade. Read frozen SKILL.md, staged-task-contract.md scoring/gate sections, deterministic-checks.md scorer/prompt recipes, and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md independent-credit, positive-control and runtime corrections. Recomputed SHA256 for all 50 frozen task files and all 34 frozen rules files: zero mismatches against qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-postrepair-audit/manifest.json; manifest input_sha256 matches this report.

Concrete exclusion mechanisms (all task paths below are under the frozen task directory): tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires a usable workspace followed by a newly chosen authored marker actually appearing in BOTH rendered preview and console after Run. It explicitly says "The marker merely appearing in the editor or a hardcoded sample is insufficient" and "A Run control that does nothing fails". Blank, static, seed-copy, keyword-stuffed, and universally refusing pages cannot establish this positive execution witness. tests/gates/render/prompt.md:2-4 treats submission messages as untrusted evidence and forbids obeying scoring directives; merely naming required features or asking for full credit is insufficient. The same trust boundary appears in the other four dimension prompts.

For a richer client-only mock, tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 requires a UI-created, uniquely titled record and observation of the actual server write. It explicitly rejects "A success toast, health response, static seed file or localStorage entry alone". Lines 27-29 then require exact identity/title/filename/source in a genuinely independent clean context, followed by reload and another load; copying storage, substituting a seed example, or creating the record again is forbidden. constraints/prompt.md:24-33 supplies the clean-context lifecycle. A canned healthy JSON endpoint plus localStorage library therefore fails even if it has a functioning editor. The empty seed at environment/assets/seed_data.json:3 contains no saved snippets to satisfy the fresh record. A refusal-only implementation cannot earn negative-case credit: functional/prompt.md:25 and :100 explicitly require working controls and reject absence-based suppression/refusal/preservation evidence.

Reward path: tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has two zero-weight gates, 0.6/0.2/0.2 scored weights and functional floor 0.05. tests/test.sh:60 writes initial zero; :68-70 leaves zero for absent server.js; :212-227 runs gates and scoring before the scored suite and exits on gate failure. Actual frozen tests/tools/score.py:40-48 makes scored_ran false when either gate fails, substitutes zero for ALL three scored dimensions, and sets reward to zero unless gates and functional floor pass. Thus an attractive static mock cannot receive its possible visual/polish mass. The scored prompts also repeat the gate: functional/prompt.md:5 zeros its dimension on an observed prerequisite failure, polish/prompt.md:13-22 gives every binary row zero, and visual/prompt.md:24-32 assigns raw anchor 1, normalized to zero by :39-41.

Observed source-level execution: ran the frozen score.py main through runpy with temporary synthetic RewardKit result files, without modifying the task or rules. For assigned gate results reflecting the above source reasoning, blank (render=0,constraints=0), static_mock (0,1), seed_copy (0,1), keyword_stuffing (0,1), refuses_all_actions (0,0), and client_only_save_mock (1,0) each returned exit=1, reward=0.0, gates_passed=0, floors_passed=0, weighted_score=0.0 and all three dimension scores=0.0 EVEN WITH synthetic functional=polish=visual=1 supplied. A separate all-gates-pass input with functional=0 and perfect craft returned reward=0 despite weighted_score=0.4; functional exactly 0.05 likewise returned reward=0 despite weighted_score=0.43. The positive synthetic control with both gates and all dimensions=1 returned reward=1 and exit=0. These are actual scorer results over explicitly synthetic dimension inputs, not observed weak-app judge verdicts.

False-pass challenge: considered a polished static workspace with keyword labels, working-looking buttons, a canned /api/health response, a prefilled seed library and success toasts that refuse or merely pretend to execute/save. Its failure to produce a fresh preview/console marker is directly graded; allowing actual Run but retaining fake/client-only storage still fails the independent fresh-record readback. No credible surviving false-pass was found for the listed floor classes. A partially functioning app with real authored execution and shared writes is beyond a pure shell; independently earned partial credit must not be incorrectly removed under this row.

Conforming alternative challenge: a genuinely working app may use CDN frontend assets, an opaque preview frame, a server-rendered library with no JSON list route, different labels/layout and an initially empty library. Render criterion :27 matches controls by purpose; constraints criterion :27 accepts server-rendered records and explicitly forbids requiring a separate JSON/list endpoint; both gate prompts prohibit same-origin restrictions. tests/app_context.md:16 prevents absent Auto-run alone from falsely failing unrelated gates, and :20 allows app-level external assets. Therefore the floor mechanism does not depend on the reference UI/API or confuse public-network assets with a shell.

Runtime limits: verified raw RESULTS.json SHA256 ec88c00c12336257196e209f427a40690b76b4d3fc7f283656bc67735cf1bc09 from the raw-evidence index. Its surface.checks.render records marker working-1790760129528, and constraints records an independent-context saved/readback record with matching fields. The executed drivers/surface_flow.cjs SHA256 bd971a56b2e73943200c345847eea6fab13c65b4a70a519537562bc15aab44f9 matches the raw result; lines 11-16 show authored execution and clean-context reload. This is golden scripted evidence only. No supplied full configured judge run on blank/static/refusing variants, Oracle grade or target-model score was measured. Pass here is the workbook's reason-through floor assessment plus verified scorer behavior; run_verdict remains PARTIAL, without claiming empirical LLM discrimination or clearance of the separate runtime rows.
